card.name: IRR abbreviation for infusion reactions
card.fires_on: The abbreviation IRR (or IRRs) in parentheses right after the phrase infusion-related reaction(s), including its split pieces such as I-RR or IR-Rs. It appears in warnings and dose-modification sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Defining the abbreviation
modes.description: IRR placed in brackets right after infusion-related reactions to introduce it.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Infusion-Related Reactions (<<IRR>>) : Interrupt infusion at the first sign

modes.label: Abbreviation split or plural
modes.description: The abbreviation is broken into pieces or pluralized as IRs, and the marked piece is the final part.
